title: Next breaking release: growable options parameter on all 30 typed *_set fns
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C13. Crates: jmap-calendars-client, jmap-chat-mimi-client, jmap-contacts-client, jmap-filenode-client, jmap-graph-client, jmap-mail-client, jmap-scene-client, jmap-sharing-client, jmap-tasks-client, jmap-vtc-client (and jmap-base-client for the shared options type). Size: L.

Follow-up from decision 8 (docs/design/DECISIONS.md; docs/design/conditional.md §8, §9 Compatibility). BREAKING, schedule for the next breaking release only. Give each of the 30 typed *_set client fns (address_book_set ... vtc_recording_set) one growable #[non_exhaustive] options parameter (e.g. SetOptions in jmap-base-client) carrying conditional-02 ConditionalSetArgs and object-history-03 restore together, so later per-set options need no signature change; using gains the conditional URI only when conditional args are non-default. Then reimplement filenode_set_conditional on it (keep it as a #[deprecated] wrapper per the repo stability policy) . Acceptance: every typed *_set fn takes the options parameter; one wiremock test per crate showing ifUnchangedBy/atomic serialized and default options producing byte-identical requests to today; CHANGELOG BREAKING entry; public-api snapshots updated.
